The Hopf axiom (3.13) is satisfied when the cusps are chosen to satisfy the swallowtail equations. In this framework, the fact that every dual can be made coherent [Pst14, Corollary 2.8] corresponds precisely to the fact that any natural isomorphism constructed above can be modified to satisfy (3.13) as stated by Neuchl.

We are now able to construct the double of a Hopf category. For any monoidal 2-category ${\mathcal{C}}$ , there exists a Drinfeld center ${\mathcal{Z}}({\mathcal{C}})$ [BN95], which is finite semisimple if ${\mathcal{C}}$ is [Déc23]. Additionally, ${\mathcal{Z}}({\mathcal{C}})$ comes equipped with a locally faithful, monoidal forgetful functor to ${\mathcal{C}}$ .

Construction 3.16.

The quantum double of a Hopf category $C$ is the Hopf category $\End(\tilde{\mathcal{F}})$ , where $\tilde{\mathcal{F}}$ is the composite fiber functor ${\mathcal{Z}}({\sf Mod}(C))\to{\sf Mod}(C)\to{\sf 2Vec}$ .

Appendix A Calculations for 2-categories

In this appendix we explicitly define the symmetric monoidal 2-category structure on ${\sf 2Slice}$ and verify that ${\mathcal{Q}}$ is a symmetric monoidal functor, as well as the antipode axiom.

A.1 The monoidal 2-category 2-slice

To start, we work with any finite semisimple 2-category ${\mathcal{V}}$ . We work in a slightly more general context so that these results will apply to the underlying 2-functors in the enriched case.

paper.title: Tannaka-Krein reconstruction for fusion 2-categories
paper.abstract: We reprove the classical Tannaka-Krein reconstruction theorem by finding a monoidal equivalence of categories between a 1-truncated sub-2-category of the slice 2-category ${\sf Mod}({\sf Vec})/{\sf Vec}$ and the category of algebras. We then immediately generalize this approach to find a monoidal equivalence of 2-categories between a 2-truncated sub-3-category of the slice 3-category ${\sf Mod}({\sf TwoVec})/{\sf TwoVec}$ and the category of algebras. As an immediate consequence, a finite semisimple 2-Hopf algebra $C$ can be recovered from its fusion 2-category of modules together with the monoidal fiber 2-functor to ${\sf TwoVec}$. Moreover, every fusion 2-category equipped with a monoidal functor to ${\sf TwoVec}$ is of this form.
